optimizedSource: The working source tree committed together with this report; no benchmark-only implementation changes.
method: Sequential runs in a shared container with warm filesystem caches. Each fixture has one primary checkout, N linked task workspaces, and 1000 added tracked files. No preview connections or user/global Git configuration. Each measured operation runs 12 times and includes Git Trace2 overhead. Cold means a new WorkflowService without retained verdicts, not cold filesystem caches. CPU and RSS measurements cover the Node process including Rust, not Git child processes.
